terra.problem: The phrase "wrong house" uses "wrong" to describe the baker's answer, even as a comparison.
Peter does not say that what redeemed them had to be something that lasts.
Peter says they were not redeemed with silver or gold; he does not say those things couldn't redeem them.
The claim that prophets prayed is a Bible fact from outside the passage and needs a reference.
Identifying Moses as Israel's leader adds a Bible fact from outside the passage without a reference.
The claim that nothing else in the passage has that kind of staying power goes beyond what Peter says.
The claims that the apostles did faithful work and that Peter was an apostle need references because they are Bible facts from outside the passage.
